content: I will be presenting a paper and a poster at HRI conference in Edinburgh, UK!
I attended the CRA-WP workshop at Seattle! I gave a 3-min lightning talk and led a Birds-of-a-Feather session.
One paper has been accepted to HRI.
My first paper in HRI area has been accepted to RO-MAN.
My first-authored paper (from my undergrad days!) has been accepted to DIS'25!
Our paper won the Best Paper Award at CHI'24.
